reviews.review: After 100 hours I still feel new to this game. This game feels like an endless grind, and I'm all here for it.  Korean games often cater to people who enjoy grinding, so if you hate grinding then this game prolly ain't for you. At this point I am one with the grind, and it feels like I'm wasting time when I'm not grinding in this game. The characters are all great looking as expected of a cultured Korean studio.  The gameplay feels amazing and responsive. The graphics are fantastic. I played during the beta and honestly thought it was pretty jank. Two months after official release I start and wow, all of a sudden it feels great to play and I'm having too much fun.

so after three days of trying over and over again to get an item that has a 38% drop rate where it takes 2 missions per attempt I decided that i was done with this game.

If you like all the major items you craft to be gated behind what is a weird multiple attempt lootbox system, then this is your game. If not, stay the heck away.
I do not know why but this does not satisfy anything...

If you love a good time killer, and like to grind for weapons this is a good game to play. Nearly everything in the store is available through play, only extra descendant/inventory slots is the one thing you will have to purchase. Meta is Bunny/Valby/Hailey atm, but any character can be fun. I main Blair/Ajax/Hailey currently, and its a blast. 

Only downside is that the tutorials should be more in depth. Especially regarding bosses (Void Intercept) But if you like a time killer and just mobbing trash, this is a great game to play. (Also its crossave! So you can play your account from Steam/PSN/Xbox)
It's fun game to play with friends or solo, good experience and character design.
Fun looter shooter game. Plenty of build variety and a lot of good loot and characters to grind for. 9/10
It has good gameplay with devs that really listen to the community and are very fast in making changes. Can be a bit too grindy at times, but that is just the nature of pure rng.

The First Descendant: An Unforgettable Journey into the Realm of Heroic Adventure

In the ever-expanding universe of action RPGs and cooperative shooters, The First Descendant emerges as a monumental triumph, blending exhilarating gameplay, intricate world-building, and profound storytelling into a singularly remarkable experience. Developed by the talented team at Nexon Games, The First Descendant is not just another entry into the genre; it’s a groundbreaking odyssey that sets new standards for immersive gameplay and narrative depth. This awe-inspiring title is poised to captivate players with its innovative design, rich lore, and breathtaking mechanics, delivering an adventure that is as grand as it is unforgettable.

A Visually Stunning and Immersive World

From the very beginning, The First Descendant captures the imagination with its strikingly beautiful and meticulously crafted world. The game’s visuals are nothing short of spectacular, combining high-fidelity graphics with a vibrant and diverse artistic style that brings its universe to life. The environments are vast and varied, ranging from lush, alien landscapes to futuristic cityscapes, each rendered with an eye for detail and atmosphere.

The level of environmental detail is extraordinary. Whether you’re exploring the crumbling ruins of an ancient civilization or traversing the gleaming towers of a high-tech metropolis, every location feels distinct and immersive. The dynamic weather systems and day-night cycles further enhance the sense of realism, creating a living, breathing world that reacts to the players’ actions and the passage of time.

A Compelling and Epic Narrative

At the heart of The First Descendant is a narrative that is as captivating as it is expansive. The game introduces players to a richly developed world with a deep and engaging lore. The story unfolds through a combination of cinematic cutscenes, immersive dialogue, and environmental storytelling, drawing players into a complex and intriguing universe.

The plot centers around the conflict between the human race and an enigmatic alien threat known as the “Invasions.” Players assume the role of “Descendants,” powerful heroes gifted with extraordinary abilities, tasked with defending humanity and uncovering the mysteries of the alien invasion. The narrative is filled with twists and turns, memorable characters, and epic moments that keep players invested in the story from start to finish.

Character development is a strong point in The First Descendant. Each character is well-rounded and distinct, with their own backstories, motivations, and arcs. The interactions between characters are nuanced and meaningful, contributing to a sense of emotional depth and connection. The game’s voice acting and dialogue are top-notch, further enhancing the storytelling experience and making every encounter feel impactful.

Innovative Gameplay and Mechanics

The First Descendant excels in delivering a gameplay experience that is both thrilling and deeply satisfying. The game blends elements of third-person shooting, RPG mechanics, and cooperative play into a cohesive and engaging package. The combat system is a highlight, featuring fluid and responsive controls that allow players to execute a wide range of abilities and strategies.

One of the most exciting aspects of The First Descendant is its emphasis on cooperative gameplay. The game supports team-based missions where players can join forces to tackle challenging objectives and formidable foes. The cooperative elements are well-designed, encouraging teamwork and coordination while providing a sense of camaraderie and shared achievement. The ability to combine different characters’ abilities and strategies adds a layer of depth and variety to the gameplay, making each mission feel dynamic and fresh.

The game’s progression system is robust and rewarding. Players can customize and upgrade their characters, unlocking new skills and abilities as they advance through the game. The diverse range of weapons, gear, and enhancements allows for a high degree of personalization, enabling players to tailor their playstyle to their preferences. The sense of progression is well-paced, with meaningful rewards and milestones that keep players motivated and engaged.

A Rich and Diverse Array of Content

The First Descendant offers a wealth of content that caters to a variety of playstyles and preferences. The game features a wide range of missions, from story-driven quests to challenging side activities, each providing unique experiences and rewards. The variety of objectives ensures that there is always something new to explore and achieve.

The game also boasts a robust endgame system, with challenging raids, high-level dungeons, and competitive modes that offer additional layers of gameplay. The endgame content is designed to provide ongoing engagement and satisfaction, with a focus on skillful play and strategic coordination.

Stellar Sound Design and Music

The audio design in The First Descendant is exceptional, with a soundtrack that complements the game’s atmosphere and enhances the overall experience. The music ranges from epic and cinematic to subtle and atmospheric, perfectly capturing the tone and mood of each moment. The sound effects, from the roar of alien creatures to the clamor of battle, are immersive and well-executed, adding depth and realism to the gameplay.

Community and Developer Engagement

The community surrounding The First Descendant is vibrant and passionate, a testament to the game’s appeal and the developers’ commitment to fostering a positive player experience. Nexon Games has demonstrated a strong dedication to engaging with the community, listening to feedback, and providing regular updates and improvements. This level of developer-player interaction contributes to a sense of shared investment and ongoing excitement within the community.

A Bright Future Ahead

In conclusion, The First Descendant is a landmark achievement in the action RPG and cooperative shooter genres. Its breathtaking visuals, compelling narrative, innovative gameplay, and rich content make it a standout title that is sure to captivate players and set new standards for future games. Nexon Games has crafted an experience that is not only grand in scope but also deeply immersive and rewarding.

For anyone seeking a game that delivers an extraordinary adventure, The First Descendant is a must-play. It stands as a testament to the creativity and ambition of its developers, offering a glimpse into a future where the boundaries of gaming are continually pushed and expanded. Whether you’re a fan of action RPGs, cooperative shooters, or simply looking for an unforgettable journey, The First Descendant promises to deliver an experience that is both awe-inspiring and endlessly enjoyable.
